neighbours.label: A noun for a measured quantity before 'of' or in a total (amount, volume, area, balance, number); promotes available, remaining, usable. Non-quantity nouns in the same frames stay quiet
fire: The total amount of water in the lake fell.
The volume of traffic doubled in June.
Le volume d'air a beaucoup augmenté.
The total area of the farm is small.
The amount of money raised was large.
The principal balance is due in May.
The total number of cases is rising.
The amount of fat in the meal is high.
quiet: The colour of water in the lake changed.
The noise of traffic grew in June.
Le bruit de l'air a beaucoup augmenté.
The owner of the farm is old.
The source of money raised was secret.
The final letter is due in May.
The first of the cases is closed.
The taste of fat in the meal is strong.
